pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.4: For an explanation of this, see comment at Bu NP 4:2.1.6.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.1.6: Agāraṁ is typically rendered as “in a house”. The problem with this is that it is not unallowable for a monastic to live in a building that is the equivalent of a house. What a monastic should not do is own a home and then live there.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.3.2: Sp 1.526: Sesakaṁ āharissāmīti dve cīvarāni katvā sesaṁ puna āharissāmīti attho, “Sesakaṁ āharissāmi: the meaning is that he says, ‘After making two robes, I will return the remainder.’”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np7:2.3.3: Presumably this refers to any leftover cloth after the robe(s) have been made.
